verdicts.explanation: The paper reports a spatial-average σQENS of 0.055 ± 0.005 S/cm at 600 K for La2/3−xLi3xTiO3 (x = 0.13), derived from QENS diffusion via Nernst-Einstein on a single crystal. Material, value, unit, temperature (600 K = 326.85 °C), origin and synthesis fields all match the paper.

field_errors.evidence: σLi ∼ 0.1 S/cm at T = 600 K reported from bulk conductivity measurements for LLTO with slightly lower Li content (x = 0.11) [5]

verdicts.explanation: The ~0.1 S/cm value at 600 K for LLTO x = 0.11 is correctly attributed to Inaguma et al. [5] as literature_cited. The paper explicitly says the value comes from bulk conductivity measurements, so 'unspecified' should be 'bulk'.
